title: Banded Lateral Walk
summary: Side steps with a resistance band around the legs, for the glute medius.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for abductors (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly abductors total.
Library rating 0.3 for glutes (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly glutes total.

setup.text: Put a band above your knees or around your ankles and sink into a quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring your trailing foot in without letting your feet touch.
Take the same number of steps in each direction.

form_cues.cue: Stay low and keep your knees pushed out the whole time.

mistakes.text: Standing up tall and letting the feet snap together.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
